title: Kulsum se Na Pucho
body:
Kulsoom se Na Pucho Kya Gham ka Marhala tha
Ahle Haram Khule Sar Sarwar ka Sar Juda tha
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dekhe'n hai'n jo Manazir kaise Baya’n Karegi,
wo waqt yaad kar ke Aah o Fugha’n Karegi,
Nok e Sina'n pe Jis dam Farq e Shahe Huda tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Roti rahi Qaza bhi jiski Qaza pe Paiham,
Mehshar Bapa huwa aur Arz o Sama me Matam,
Jab ran me Sar burida Dilband e Fatima tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tukdo’n me bat chuka tha Paamal e Zulm hokar,
Taapo’n ki zadd me aaya jab wo Nishan e Shabbar,
Sehre ki tarha Qasim Maqtal me Jaa ba Jaa tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye uska Dil hi jaane kya purmahan Ghadi thi,
Karbobala me jis dam Ghash khaake gir padi thi,
Aur nahr pe tadapta Abbas e Bawafa tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mehsus Yu'n kiya hai khud dard e Umme Laila,
Barchi ki Us Ani ko Apne hi Dil me dekha,
Tar Khu’n me jisko khakar Gulgo’n Qaba huwa tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Nazro'n me aaj bhi hai Fart e Alam ki Saa'at,
Haye Haye Rubab par wo tuti thi kya Qayamat,
Teer e Sitam me Uljha Asghar ka jab Gala tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Karbal se jo Chali thi hokar ke Gham ki Haamil,
Zainab ke Dard me thi ye har Qadam pe Shaamil,
Taaraj ho chuka jo Gulzar e Mustafa tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ab Jaan lo Nahi ho Kufe ki Shaahzaadi,
Bankar ho aayi Qaidi Chadar ki ho Sawali,
Ye Shimr e Bad Nasab ne Kulsoom se Kaha tha,
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Karta tha Jab ‘Shabih e Abbas’ Nauhagoyi,
Masruf e Gham hui thi Sangat Rasool e Haq ki,
Aur Saath Mehwe Matam unke huwa ‘Wila’ tha...
